summary: Moves the working `set_paths` implementation up to the base `Collection` class and drops the now-redundant `PathCollection` override, correctly enabling `ContourSet.set_paths` as requested. Minimal, correct, and idiomatic; safe to merge.

issues.description: New base-class `set_paths` (and the existing `get_paths`) lack a docstring; a one-line docstring would help the public API surface, but matching siblings already omit it so this is a nit, not blocking.
